subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does the reporter have enough concrete evidence to open a private ACP approval-bypass investigation, or should maintainers first require a current-main trace and deterministic reproducer?
rationale: The claimed impact is security-sensitive, but the described asynchronous tokenization and token-limit mechanism does not match the observed current-main permission path, so maintainer security judgment is needed before requesting or discussing exploit details publicly.
